target_customer: Retail traders in India who want exposure to US stocks without a US brokerage account
problem: Indians face friction and remittance limits when trading US markets. Mochatrade offers rupee funded, UPI deposited, leveraged trading of contracts tracking US stocks, around the clock.
business_model: Trading fees on leveraged perpetual contracts, built on Hyperliquid
product_category: Consumer fintech, crypto derivatives on US equities

founders.name: Utkarsh Sinha
previous_startups: Martian Wallet (2M+ installs, raised $3.5M, acquired, per the YC page)

founders.name: Parth Maheshwari
founders.background_notes: Was on a small team that built Photoshop for the web, per the YC page.

founders.name: Chetan Manda
education: IIT Guwahati (listed as HCI graduate, per the YC page)
previous_startups: Meadow (CEO, acquired by a YC company)
founders.background_notes: Director of Product at Sprinklr. Technical status inferred from product role, not stated.

competitors.name: Mudrex
competitors.what: Offers tokenized US stock perpetuals with up to 10x leverage and INR margin

competitors.name: Indian US stock brokers such as INDmoney and Vested
competitors.what: Conventional access to US shares for Indians
competitors.traction_then: Indians put over $2.2B into overseas assets in the 11 months to Feb 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Builds on Hyperliquid for contracts and settlement, so the hard parts are INR on and off ramps via UPI, risk and liquidation handling with up to 50x leverage, and compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Registered with FIU-IND as a VDASP per its site, which is a modest compliance position. The product layer sits on a shared protocol and is copyable by other Indian crypto apps.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Crypto exchanges were pushing 24/7 stock products into India in 2026. No acquisition reported.

market_need_then: Strong Indian retail appetite for US equities (over $2.2B overseas investment in 11 months to Feb 2026) and a 20,000 person waitlist reported in Oct 2026, against remittance friction and market hour limits.

branding.domain_note: Uses mochatrade.com exact brand plus trade suffix; no purchase history found.

identity.logo: Dark mode wordmark and a Mocha mark, with a ticker style T suffix for tokens (company site)
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and punchy short fragments such as 'Immobilised.' and 'Gone.'

branding.brand_signature: Rupee funded US markets with a 24/7 pitch
branding.community_and_virality: 20,000+ person waitlist reported by Entrepreneur India (company reported).

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable friendly name plus a clear one line promise and a large waitlist, but no independent press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Mochatrade is a Spring 2026 company that raised a reported $5.5M seed in October 2026 led by CoinFund after YC and Pioneer Fund pre seed money. The founders have prior startup exits, a clear Indian demand wedge and crypto native investors. The main risk is Indian regulation of leveraged crypto derivatives, and no outcome has occurred yet.
notes: Seed size is reported variously as $5.5M (Inc42, Entrepreneur India), $5.56M (The Block, as total raised) and about $6M (Crypto Briefing, Cryptorank). The Block reports SAFEs, so no valuation. The YC page says up to 50x leverage while one profile says 20x. Product is described as stock tokens by some outlets and perpetual futures by others. Competitors are dated 2026 near the Spring 2026 batch.
